friendly_name: Gherkin authoring aids and Specification layout
purpose_context: Feature pages generated from Gherkin are a core DocKitty surface. Authors get no feedback when steps describe UI clicks instead of behaviour, must repeat a glossary context tag in every file of a bounded-context folder, and readers cannot see a page's tags, source or draft status. This mission adds an opt-in wording check, a per-folder default glossary context, and a Specification layout with a draft notice for every draft page (issues #196, #197, #198).
purpose_tldr: Help authors write feature files that read well as living documentation, and give generated feature pages a layout that shows their status, tags and source.
